_: The single source of truth for TrueMG's colours. Every generator in this tree reads it; nothing hardcodes a hex. Change it here, re-run the generators, done.
_brand: Measured off Mila's actual flip-off caps, 11 Oct 2026. Two independent sources agreed: a bulk-bag photo gave #0A89C6, and a 7-second video of one cap in hand gave #1C8CD0 across 15 face-on frames (spread R±16 G±16 B±22). The video wins because the cap's own white plastic sits beside the blue band, which allows a LOCAL white balance rather than a guess at the room. The physical stock is the authority here, not any file.
_brandDeep: Derived from brand, not invented: the old pair (#2365CD / #13387C) sat at a lightness ratio of 0.596 and a saturation ratio of 1.037, and those ratios are carried over.
_previous: #2365CD was the brand until 11 Oct 2026. It was sampled from the Canva label artwork and was never wrong for what it was — it simply predated the caps existing. It reads violet beside the real stock.
_warning: Anodised aluminium has no single colour: the band runs bright cyan where it catches the light and deep blue where it does not. #1C8CD0 is the mid-tone, which is what a brand colour should be. If the cap supplier provides a standard colour reference, that beats this measurement and should replace it.
